decisions.reason: It is close to the firm's web shop and CMS business, and with in-house R&D the firm can learn from early demand and improve a niche Magento template.
A responsive website template fits the firm's established website project offer and can be refined with the firm's existing development and customer knowledge.
Premium customer support directly leverages the firm's core support operations, service reputation, and existing customer base, so absorptive-capacity problems are minimal.
A software version management tool builds strongly on the firm's established hosting, maintenance, and administration capabilities and is supported by its own software development.

The data-processing-contract tool is more distant from the core hosting offer and therefore harder to interpret and improve, but the firm's broad portfolio, growth, and own R&D make it plausible to keep testing it for now.
